title: Promoters
subtitle: Promoters are independent participants who select works from the catalog and promote them autonomously. No assignments. No guarantees.

sections.heading: Selecting works
sections.body: Choose any public work from the catalog. No permission required. No exclusivity.

sections.heading: Promotion is self-directed
sections.body: Promotion methods are entirely up to you. PonyLife does not provide scripts, campaigns, or messaging instructions.

sections.heading: Outcomes
sections.body: An outcome is any externally observable result linked to a work (for example: a sale, exhibition, license, or audience growth). Outcomes are uncertain.

sections.heading: Reporting (prototype)
sections.body: Promoters may report outcomes for transparency. Reporting does not imply validation, compensation, or guarantees.
